rationale: The interpreter introduces an unsupported assumption by stating that the 3/8-inch tube with 1-inch spacing increment is "instead of the generic increment", which is not mentioned in the ticket. This adds information not required by the specification and could lead to incorrect implementation behavior.

findings.description: The interpreter adds a clause that the 3/8-inch tube with 1-inch spacing increment is "instead of the generic increment", which is not present in the ticket.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported "instead of the generic increment" clause from the business rule.

sourceRefs.quote: The 3/8-inch tube with 1-inch spacing increment is 1.00 inch instead of the generic increment.
